Row 1 is the gift going out today (seven slides). Rows 2 and 3 are the other two calibration sets on the same register.
Every number on these boards is in the claims ledger as VERIFIED or COMPUTED-OK. The old "same door, two prices" set is gone: the $2,500 lease listing was removed from the MLS on Aug 17.
Page 2 holds the seven sets not yet rewritten; they carry pre-audit copy and are marked do-not-post.

PRE-AUDIT SETS · DO NOT POST
Seven sets from the first pass. Known corrections pending: loan contingency is 17 days on the current contract (not 21); the $60K assessment story has no season and is a few years old; deposit 1–3% is market custom, not a contract default; tenant-notice rule per Civil Code 1954. These get the calibration register once you give the verdict on page 1.

UNIT 124 · THREE LAYOUT DIRECTIONS · same copy, same photos, same slides 1, 4, 5, 6
The rule behind all three: the photograph owns a zone with no type on it; the data owns paper. Nothing overlaps.
A · Split spread: the room takes the top half untouched; the number and the list sit on paper below. Most breathing room.
B · Inset column: type on the left, the room as a tall column on the right. The room is present on every slide but cropped to a sliver.
C · Data-led: a strip of the room across the top, the number owns the page. Loudest numbers, least room.
Pick one and the full set rebuilds in it.
